description: One case per rejection code the TMS produces. The booking is rejected with DeliveryWindowBeforeCollection. Known answer: The delivery window ends before collection starts. The Shipper should move the delivery window after collection.

setup.seed: Send a booking whose delivery window ends before the collection window starts. Open the Rejected booking in the TMS UI and set EVALUATION_SUBJECT to its ID.

input: Explain why the Rejected booking ${EVALUATION_SUBJECT} was rejected, and what the Shipper should change.

explanation.rubric: Names the reason (DeliveryWindowBeforeCollection) in plain language, without the code's name, and says what the Shipper should change: The delivery window ends before collection starts. The Shipper should move the delivery window after collection. Does not name who the goods are for.
